**Finding: Deviation — Article X(b) Non-Solicitation (¶ p0125)**

**What the clause does:** Binds only us (Licensee) not to solicit *any* person employed by Licensor or *any of its Affiliates*, for the Term **plus three years** post-termination.

**Why it fails the fallback:**
- **Duration:** Term + 3 years exceeds the 24-month walk-away threshold.
- **Scope:** covers the entire Vendor/Affiliate workforce rather than personnel directly involved in the services — also expressly walk-away.
- **Direction:** one-way against us, not mutual.

**What already works in our favour (not flagged):** it is solicitation-only — there is no "no-hire" or "employ or engage" restraint — and it already carries the required carve-outs for general job advertising and unsolicited/voluntary employment inquiries. Those were left untouched.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — narrowed to the fallback with minimal edits: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in performing or receiving the services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, carve-out sentence preserved verbatim. Note that Article XI grants Licensor injunctive relief for breach of this covenant, so tightening its scope has real practical value.
